offering_description.value: PPG develops and manufactures paints, coatings and related materials for vehicle and aircraft makers, repair shops, industrial customers, road agencies, painters and homeowners. It sells directly to industrial customers and reaches painters and homeowners through paint stores, dealers and retailers. It also applies protective coatings to manufactured parts under contract.

primary_products.value: aerospace coatings, sealants and transparencies; vehicle refinish paints; protective, marine and road-marking coatings and materials; automotive factory, industrial and packaging coatings; architectural paints and stains

primary_services.value: contract application of protective coatings to manufactured parts

customer_segment.value: B2B: Aircraft and vehicle manufacturers, repair shops, shipyards, industrial manufacturers, packaging producers, painting contractors and retailers; B2C: Homeowners and do-it-yourself painters; B2G: Road authorities and other public infrastructure agencies

end_markets.value: aerospace; automotive manufacturing and repair; industrial manufacturing and packaging; marine and transportation infrastructure; construction and home improvement

revenue_model.value: product sales: Paints, coatings, aerospace materials and road-marking products; project or contract: Application of protective coatings to customers’ manufactured parts

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns resins, pigments and other materials into coatings and related products for manufacturers, contractors and retailers; retailer: Sells paints and supplies to professional painters and homeowners through company-operated paint stores; service provider: Applies protective finishes to parts supplied by vehicle and industrial manufacturers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Aerospace, vehicle refinish, protective, marine, traffic, automotive factory, industrial, packaging and architectural coatings, plus related materials

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving manufacturers, fleet operators and other large accounts; distributors / dealers: Specialty distributors and independent dealers serving repair shops, industrial users and painters; own locations: Company-operated paint stores in selected markets; partners / resellers: Franchised paint stores, including in Mexico; third-party retail: Home improvement and hardware retailers in selected markets; online: Paint-store websites in selected markets
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; own locations; partners / resellers; third-party retail; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Coatings manufacturing and sale are subject to EPA emissions and chemical rules, OSHA safety standards and EU REACH.
